stop_time_options.size: Up to 3,185,115 visit nodes and 6,370,230 linking edges before validity filtering.
stop_time_options.tradeoff: Supports visit-level provenance and traversals, with higher graph write, index and working-set costs.

stop_time_options.size: Up to 3,185,115 sequence-aware Trip–Stop visit edges.
stop_time_options.tradeoff: Direct trip traversal with times on the edge. A multiedge representation must preserve loops and visit order.

stop_time_options.size: 3,185,115 timetable rows plus graph connectivity projections.
stop_time_options.tradeoff: Column pruning and batch filtering support timetable queries with fewer graph objects. Cross-store lookups and provenance alignment add complexity for per-visit queries.

graph.recommendation: Benchmark an external timetable and graph connectivity as the initial design. Compare bulk load time, storage, p50/p95 selector and timetable latency, and incremental update cost against visit properties and visit nodes using the same records and queries.
